tools.name: load_toolset
tools.title: Load a toolset
tools.description: Enable an additional group of fabdesk tools for this session. Available toolsets are project (files, board settings, off-board parts library), circuit, route, kicad, verify, render, export, sim, app, shopping (fabplane.com shopping list and team inventory), and cad (the mechanical model in FreeCAD). Core tools are always available.

toolset.description: Toolset to enable. Aliases routing=route, verification=verify, rendering=render, simulation=sim are accepted; the result reports the canonical id.

tools.name: request_project_creation
tools.title: Prepare an idea for project setup
tools.description: When a user asks to generate or edit engineering files in an idea draft, record the requested next action and show project setup in fabPlane. This does not create a board or run engineering tools. After this call, stop and explain that the user can create the project or keep exploring.

instruction.description: The user's concrete requested engineering action, with the agreed requirements. Do not add unrequested work.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: pcb_environment

tools.name: project_status
tools.title: Project status
tools.description: Summarise the selected project: directory, board settings, native KiCad files, latest source/compiler build, persisted release evidence and staleness, route and verification state, sketches, reports, and explicitly declared assembly board sources/instances/connections. Assembly source availability is not compatibility evidence. Does not run ERC, DRC, or release.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_build
tools.title: Build the board
tools.description: Compile circuit.netlist.json into board.kicad_pcb and a generated board.kicad_sch. Footprints are pulled from KiCad libraries, explicitly placed when board.placements names them, and connected into the ratsnest; libSource draws all library units, including power units, with labelled wire stubs. For a rejected build, fix the source and call circuit_build again, or use schematic_edit to create native units (same reference, distinct unit numbers); schematic_inspect returns IDs for editing or replacement. Returns actionable errors/warnings, with source-format guidance and an example when the entrypoint is missing or malformed. Rebuilds replace only generated schematic items, preserve manual schematic work and unlisted manual footprint placement, keep tracks whose nets still exist, and remove footprints the netlist no longer names.

entrypoint.description: Netlist file relative to the project, default circuit.netlist.json

rebuild.description: preserve keeps compatible existing copper; clean removes routed tracks/arcs/vias after source validation before rebuilding

fresh.description: Discard the existing board first (outline, placement, tracks) and build from the netlist alone. Needed after changing the board size: a build never redraws an outline that exists.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: circuit_place
tools.title: Place footprints
tools.description: Move built-board footprints to explicit KiCad board coordinates in millimetres, with optional rotation. Tracks are not moved. Returns moved and missing references.

tools.name: route_run
tools.title: Autoroute the board
tools.description: Start a durable autoroute against a revision-bound board snapshot. Waits up to waitMs (default 20 s, max 60 s); returns the final result when the run finishes within that time, otherwise its run ID and running state. The run continues after the request returns, and its progress, diagnostics and artifacts remain available through route_status. applyPolicy=auto (default) atomically applies only while the starting PCB revision is current; manual preserves a validated native candidate for route_apply. onlyConnections limits the run to named nets.

expectedSourceSha256.description: Captured saved PCB SHA-256; required for an assembly source export

router.description: Router; capacity is a legacy fab_router alias. An unpinned project defaults to Freerouting, falling back to fab_router when unavailable or failed. Automatic selective reroutes use fab_router. Explicit Freerouting falls back only when unavailable. tracemaker is install-on-demand (Settings → Routers) and errors with an install hint if it is not installed.

timeoutMs.description: Per-router computation budget in milliseconds; default 10 minutes. Queue time and inline wait are separate. A deadline does not trigger fallback.

onlyConnections.description: Route only these leftover nets. The DSN network lists just those nets; other copper stays as obstacles. Via padstacks include existing board via sizes so sessions round-trip. If nothing routes, the result lists the leftover pads.

targets.description: Whole-net selections only. Endpoint coordinates (from/to) are unsupported and rejected before a run starts.

rules.description: Explicit routing width, clearance, via and zone rules; the router uses the board's enabled copper layers

perNet.description: Per-net width and via overrides; override global fields and net classes

pairs.description: Declared pairs for measurement; current routers route members independently. Pair width applies to both members; conflicting per-net widths are rejected

rerouteMode.description: Scoped nets only: onOpen (default) makes one additional clean routing attempt when opens remain; always removes their own copper; never routes with retained copper only. Other nets stay protected; the best native-clean candidate wins.

freeroutingPasses.description: Freerouting pass budget; default 100. The time limit still applies.

allowQualityRegression.description: Explicitly allow warned width narrowing or increased pair skew. Default holds these candidates for inspection; scope and native DRC errors can never be allowed.

applyPolicy.description: auto applies only if the starting PCB revision is still current; manual preserves a candidate for route_apply

waitMs.description: Milliseconds this request waits for the run to finish (including auto apply). A run that finishes in time returns its final status; otherwise the response is the running state. 0 returns immediately. The run continues after the request returns either way.

tools.name: verify_drc
tools.title: Run KiCad DRC
tools.description: Run KiCad design rule check on board.kicad_pcb. When parity is enabled, require a complete saved schematic hierarchy and bind parity evidence to its aggregate revision. Explicit assembly members currently support PCB-only DRC: provide expectedSourceSha256 and schematicParity=false. Returns violation descriptions, rule types and native item IDs with actionable geometry; responseMode=full returns all rows. Writes reports/drc.json inside the selected source directory.

expectedSourceSha256.description: Required for an assembly member: SHA256 of its inspected saved PCB

severity.description: Report all severities or errors only

limit.description: Max violations per category in the response (maximum 200). Every violation is in reports/drc.json regardless; this only bounds the inline sample.

responseMode.description: summary: counts, per-rule totals and a byte-bounded sample without per-violation geometry rows. full: the complete enriched violations inline, which costs roughly 1 KiB per violation.

refreshChecks.description: Run packaged-kicad-cli full-severity ERC and parity-enabled DRC for these exact saved files

responseMode.description: Return the complete inspection inline, or a bounded reference to the complete saved report

mechanical.description: Measure per-footprint 3D model coverage, transformed bounds and heights with packaged kicad-cli (cached by PCB and model-file content)

tools.name: pcb_inspect
tools.title: Inspect a PCB region
tools.description: Optional board selects a declared assembly source at its captured manifest SHA; results include _board identity. Assembly roots require explicit source selection. routing_quality returns per-net copper widths, planar chord length, via counts and sizes, layers, and name-identified pairs; accepts nets and is requested alone. Inspect a bounded part of the saved native PCB by item kind, reference, net, layer, rectangle, or point/radius. Layers accept F.Cu, BL_F_Cu, or the KiCad enum number (3); vias occupy every copper layer they span. board_geometry returns board-owned outline and graphic shapes; request footprint_geometry explicitly for footprint-owned courtyard and fabrication primitives, and include zones to see pour occupancy. islandsOfNet returns the copper islands of those nets (pad/via/track/zone connectivity). Returns compact exact millimetre coordinates, AABB, source revision, bounds, and a truncation indicator.

references.description: Filter components, pads, and footprint_geometry by reference. Tracks, vias, zones, and unrouted edges match when they directly touch the referenced footprints' pads, regardless of net. This filter does not apply to nets, keepouts, board_geometry, or texts; use nets, region, or near for those kinds.

region.description: Inclusive PCB rectangle in millimetres. Items are matched by their body, not their centre: a pad or via whose copper reaches into the rectangle is reported, and a zone covering it is reported. Pad rows carry no rotation, so a pad is matched by its largest dimension in both axes — occupancy is never under-reported and a long thin pad may be reported conservatively.

near.description: Items touching this point/radius in millimetres

islandsOfNet.description: Return connected copper islands for these nets (pad/via/track/zone graph)

tools.name: pcb_edit_copper
tools.title: Atomically edit PCB copper
tools.description: Atomically validate and apply native tracks, vias, copper deletion by inspected ID, or removal of named routed nets in one recoverable transaction. The normal mode=apply path validates before saving and restores prior files if rejected; use mode=preview only when a non-mutating forecast is specifically needed. For reroutes, write a project-local JSON candidate and pass candidateFile with removeNets so old copper is replaced in one recoverable transaction. Applying named-net removal without replacement requires an explicit commitRemovalOnly acknowledgement. Track endpoints accept exact millimetre points or semantic {reference,pad} endpoints resolved from the saved board. Rejects stale PCB revisions.

end.description: Exact millimetre point or a footprint pad resolved to its exact saved-board position

items.description: KiCad layer name such as F.Cu, B.Cu, F.SilkS, B.SilkS, or Edge.Cuts; numeric IDs remain accepted

candidateFile.description: Project-relative JSON file containing {tracks:[...], vias:[...]}; keeps large generated routes durable and out of the tool-call payload

commitRemovalOnly.description: Explicitly acknowledge that named-net copper removal should persist without replacement geometry

tools.name: schematic_inspect
tools.title: Inspect native schematic
tools.description: Explicit assembly members support saved-hierarchy summary only; live member authoring and object selection remain unavailable. Inspect selected native schematic objects using the union of references, netNames and objectIds; optional expand=nets includes their connected electrical objects. Pins are absolute sheet millimetres. Reuse wire.start/end and label.position in schematic_edit; junctions use junction.position as {x,y}, deleteItemIds uses object.id. Inspect-to-edit: {junctions:[result.junctions[0].position],deleteItemIds:[result.wires[0].id],sheet:result.scope.identity}. Selectors request object detail even with summary. Inspect the complete saved native schematic hierarchy. The default is a compact packaged-KiCad project summary; request authoring or full for bounded live KiCad IPC details on the root/current or one selected sheet. Live session diagnostics include issue descriptions, itemIds and danglingItemIds (up to 200 issues; issueCount reports the total) and are never presented as saved-file ERC.

detail.description: summary=count/check overview; authoring=symbols and pins; full=all wires, labels, nets and deletion IDs

sheet.description: For authoring/full detail, select inspected scope.identity (uuid:path), or one unambiguous hierarchy path, sheet name, or native filename

references.description: Component references on selected sheet; union with netNames and objectIds

tools.name: schematic_edit
tools.title: Edit native schematic
tools.description: Apply one undoable edit batch directly to board.kicad_sch. Multi-unit parts share reference/libId/value/footprint with distinct unit numbers; place every required unit, including power units. Use symbolUpdates {reference,unit} for a placed unit or deleteItemIds from schematic_inspect to replace it. Supports rotated or mirrored library symbols, symbol movement, safely labelled pin stubs, explicit wires, local and global labels, junctions, no-connect markers, notes, and deletion by inspected ID. Creates native KiCad files when absent. Coordinates are absolute sheet millimetres, origin top-left, +X right, +Y down, on KiCad's 1.27 mm grid. Off-grid arguments are preserved and reported as gridProblems. Each batch uses one commit; changedObjectIds and revision describe the applied result.

tools.name: shopping_list_add
tools.title: Add items to the shopping list
tools.description: Append lines to the project's shopping list, creating the list if the project has none yet (named after the project and tagged with its git remotes). Use for parts not in the netlist, spares, tools, or a specific distributor listing. Each item needs a quantity; set destination to route it to a distributor or "manual". Items without refs are kept across BOM re-syncs. Returns the added items and the updated list.

kind.description: "part" (default) for components, "pcb" for the bare board order, "other" for tools/consumables

destination.description: Where to buy it: a destination id ("builtin:digikey", a custom uuid), built-in key ("jlcpcb", "manual") or name ("DigiKey Thailand"). Default: the cart's fab house (JLCPCB), which assembles/sources everything not moved elsewhere.

sku.description: Distributor part number or LCSC C-number

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: shopping_list_update
tools.title: Update a shopping list item
tools.description: Change one shopping-list line by item id (from shopping_list_get): quantity, destination (move it from JLCPCB to a distributor or "manual"), status (needed → ordered → received), notes, sku/url/price or part fields. Only the fields you pass change. BOM re-syncs keep destination, status and notes.

kind.description: "part" (default) for components, "pcb" for the bare board order, "other" for tools/consumables

destination.description: Where to buy it: a destination id ("builtin:digikey", a custom uuid), built-in key ("jlcpcb", "manual") or name ("DigiKey Thailand"). Default: the cart's fab house (JLCPCB), which assembles/sources everything not moved elsewhere.

sku.description: Distributor part number or LCSC C-number

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: shopping_list_remove
tools.title: Remove a shopping list item
tools.description: Delete one line from the project's shopping list by item id. A line that came from the BOM returns on the next shopping_list_sync_bom unless the part is removed from the design; set quantity 0 instead to keep it out.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: shopping_list_sync_bom
tools.title: Sync the shopping list from the BOM
tools.description: Sync the captured project BOM (native schematic exclusions, declared board instances and project hardware) to Shopping. Review bom_read first and pass expectedRevision. Partial coverage needs explicit allowPartial and keeps unmatched saved items; matched supplier/status/notes and manual lines remain. Single-board projects retain the default editable PCB fabrication line; assemblies do not infer a generic PCB order. Does not place an order.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: shopping_list_destinations
tools.title: List or add purchase destinations
tools.description: List where shopping-list items can be bought: built-in fab houses (JLCPCB, PCBWay, OSH Park), distributors (DigiKey, Mouser, LCSC, …), "Manual purchase", and the org's custom destinations. Pass `add` to create a custom destination (org admins only), e.g. { name: "DigiKey Thailand", url: "https://www.digikey.co.th", baseId: "builtin:digikey" }.

baseId.description: Built-in destination this is a regional variant of, e.g. "builtin:digikey"

tools.name: inventory_search
tools.title: Search the team inventory
tools.description: Search the active fabplane org's parts inventory (what the team already has on the shelf) by text (name, MPN, manufacturer, description, SKU; case-insensitive) and optionally category, location or tag. Shows whether a part for the shopping list is already in stock. Returns items with id, quantity, unit, location, tags, attributes and image URLs; pass nextCursor back as cursor for more.

tools.name: inventory_add
tools.title: Add an item to the team inventory
tools.description: Record a part the team has on hand in the active fabplane org's inventory. You (the local agent) do the extraction: read labels, photos or datasheets yourself and send the structured fields plus any semi-structured facts as `attributes` (e.g. { package: "SOT-23", voltage_v: 3.3, esd_sensitive: true }). The server does no AI processing. Pass externalId to make repeated adds idempotent (same externalId updates the existing item). Images are not uploaded by this tool.

tools.name: cad_status
tools.title: FreeCAD status
tools.description: Report whether the FabPlane CAD bridge is reachable and which FreeCAD it runs, and summarise the current project's model (model.FCStd) when a project is selected.

tools.name: cad_model
tools.title: List CAD model objects
tools.description: List the objects of the project's FreeCAD model (model.FCStd, created empty on first use): internal name, label, type, recompute status, children and bounding-box size in mm.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_properties
tools.title: Read CAD object properties
tools.description: Read an object's properties (value, unit, expression, group) from the project's FreeCAD model. Pass `names` to read only some.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_add_object
tools.title: Add CAD object
tools.description: Add a FreeCAD object to the project's model (e.g. Part::Box, Part::Cylinder, Part::Cut, PartDesign::Body, Sketcher::SketchObject), set its properties, recompute and save.

name.description: Internal name; FreeCAD picks one when omitted

properties.description: Property name → value. Numbers are in FreeCAD base units (mm, deg); strings may carry units ("25 mm", "1 in"); vectors, placements and links use the FreeCAD API's tagged form, e.g. {"$type":"Vector","x":0,"y":0,"z":5}.

group.description: Internal name of a group or body to add it to

kernel.description: Which geometry kernel owns this object. FreeCAD objects are always OpenCascade; use cad_build_part to build on SMLib.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_set_properties
tools.title: Set CAD object properties
tools.description: Set properties of an object in the project's FreeCAD model (one undo step), optionally bind expressions (`expressions`: path → formula, null clears), then recompute and save.

values.description: Property name → value. Numbers are in FreeCAD base units (mm, deg); strings may carry units ("25 mm", "1 in"); vectors, placements and links use the FreeCAD API's tagged form, e.g. {"$type":"Vector","x":0,"y":0,"z":5}.

expressions.description: Property path → expression, e.g. {"Height": "Box.Length * 2"}; null clears

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_remove_object
tools.title: Remove CAD object
tools.description: Remove an object from the project's FreeCAD model (with `recursive`, also the objects it claims as children), then recompute and save. Undo with cad_undo.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_recompute
tools.title: Recompute CAD model
tools.description: Recompute the project's FreeCAD model and save it; reports objects that failed to recompute.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_undo
tools.title: Undo / redo in the CAD model
tools.description: Undo (or with `redo`, redo) the last change to the project's FreeCAD model, recompute and save. Returns the remaining undo and redo steps.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_export
tools.title: Export CAD model
tools.description: Export objects of the project's FreeCAD model (default: every visible top-level shape) to exports/<name>.<format> as STEP, IGES, BREP, STL or OBJ, e.g. an enclosure for printing or a STEP for the board's 3D check.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_python
tools.title: Run FreeCAD Python
tools.description: Run Python in the project's FreeCAD session (`FreeCAD`/`App`, `Part`, `Sketcher`, `PartDesign` importable; the model is `App.ActiveDocument`), for work the other cad tools do not cover: sketches with constraints, pads and pockets, booleans, fillets. The model is recomputed and saved afterwards. Returns stdout, stderr, an expression's repr, or the exception.

mode.description: auto evaluates an expression and falls back to executing statements

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_view
tools.title: Open the CAD view
tools.description: Return the URL of the fab_cad web UI attached to the project's live FreeCAD session (what the app's CAD tab shows), and the session's WebSocket for a FreeCAD API client.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_kernels
tools.title: List CAD kernels
tools.description: List geometry kernels (OpenCascade / FreeCAD by default, experimental SMLib when FABDESK_EXPERIMENTAL_CAD_KERNELS=1), their capabilities and availability, and each part already built for this project (which kernel built it, and why it switched).

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_build_part
tools.title: Build a CAD part on a chosen kernel
tools.description: Build one mechanical part from a kernel-agnostic feature list (box/cylinder/sphere, fillet, chamfer, cut_cylinder). `kernel` is auto (heuristic: G2/consumer → SMLib, machined/prismatic → OpenCascade), or an explicit kernel. When the chosen kernel fails a feature, the next available kernel is tried and the switch is recorded. Writes cad/parts/<id>.step and cad/kernels.json.

id.description: Part id, used as the STEP file name

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_combine_parts
tools.title: Combine CAD parts into one model
tools.description: Bring every part in cad/kernels.json together as one project model via STEP (SMLib fuse when the experimental kernel is up; otherwise a remapped ISO-10303-21 assembly). Writes cad/assembly.step.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_enclosure
tools.title: Generate a board-synced enclosure
tools.description: Generate a printable two-piece enclosure from board.kicad_pcb (Edge.Cuts outline, NPTH / mounting holes, edge connectors, tall parts). v2 adds a separate outline offset, vent patterns (grid / slots / honeycomb), snap-fit clips, an SVG preview, and STL/STEP export. Cutouts and standoffs stay keyed to the board hash. Writes enclosure.json plus exports/<name>.stl, <name>-lid.stl, <name>.step and <name>-preview.svg. FreeCAD is optional — when the CAD bridge is up, the same primitives are mirrored into model.FCStd.

boardPath.description: Optional project-relative placement snapshot. Uses isolated placement/enclosure outputs and never mirrors into FreeCAD.

action.description: preview returns meshes without writing; generate writes the case; status reports sync; check compares cutouts to the current board

expectedBoardRevision.description: Reject apply if the board changed since preview

snapFit.description: Through-lid snap-fit clips on the long walls

applyToCad.description: When the FabPlane CAD bridge is running, also update model.FCStd

name.description: Output base name under exports/ and enclosure.json

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.

tools.name: cad_fit
tools.title: Design enclosure space and edit PCB fit
tools.description: Save confirmed interior dimensions, board placements, obstacles, mounts and openings; check conservative clearance envelopes; preview/build a case; apply native PCB outline, mounting-hole and component edits; export a revision-matched design ZIP. model_preview displays a project-relative STEP sourcePath using an isolated FreeCAD session, without changing the original or project CAD model. Imported STL/STEP modification uses FreeCAD and preserves the original. Fit checks are not a fabrication certification.

project.description: Project id, name or absolute path. Optional when the session already has a current project.
